files.name: motion-prompt-059.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Toggle switch" (トグルスイッチ), one of the names in "UI component names".
Motion Prompt #059

What it is: Flip a setting on or off
What the sample shows: The switches on the first two of three setting rows are turned on in turn, then off again.
Spec:
- 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Three setting rows 60 px apart with dividers. At x 450 a 64×34 track (radius 17) and a white knob (radius 13, shadow).
- Clicks: row 1 on at 1.0 s, row 2 on at 1.8 s, row 1 off at 3.0 s, row 2 off at 3.6 s. Row 3 stays off.
- Each switch takes 0.2 s with easeOutCubic; the knob slides 30 px (17 → 47).
- The track colour blends from grey #d9d7d5 to blue #1f5ae8 with the switch progress.
When to use it: Use it for settings that take effect immediately and have only two states.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/059.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/ui.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
